summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the synthetic voting maps for its Annual and Extraordinary General Meetings scheduled for April 30, 2026. The filings are routine governance updates showing votes by shareholders on standard agenda items, such as approval of financial statements, profit allocation, compensation, and election of fiscal council members. Notably, the Extraordinary General Meeting includes approval of the merger of wholly-owned subsidiaries Baovale Mineração S.A. and CDA Logística S.A., but this is an internal reorganization without external consideration or special-situation characteristics. No pricing, premium, or advisor details are provided as it is not a third-party transaction. This is a routine current report under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation.
